summary: Keep published agent rosters and collection views available when the background retirement-identity import finishes. Changing retirement authority invalidates replication inventory without withdrawing graph-equivalent publications, so a successful roster publication barrier remains valid during startup maintenance.

replay.detail: No replay behavior changes; actual graph replacement still invalidates views.

rules.detail: Retirement authority, admission decisions, and retention rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No protocol or generated client changes.

downtime.detail: Authority changes no longer withdraw existing graph publications.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new recovery restrictions.
